title: PyYAML load without a safe loader (python)
description: Code in python calls yaml.load without a Loader argument. The default loader can construct arbitrary Python objects from tags, so untrusted YAML can execute code. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms trust or uses yaml.safe_load(stream).
remediation: Use yaml.safe_load(stream), or pass Loader=SafeLoader explicitly.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags any yaml.load call on a line with no Loader= argument. Loader= set on a later line is not seen.
